cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before your caretaker interview, apologise to that chair. You sat without its consent. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then tell it you're sorry for taking silence as permission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, chair. I'll stand for the interview.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for making it redundant. You're applying to care for furniture, and your first solution is to leave it without a job.

mechanism: A conducts an interview through chair apologies, waiving response and seating requirements so B keeps acknowledging impossible duties to furniture.
confusable: Unlike ordinary manners, consent and employment obligations belong to the chair, and each practical workaround creates another apology.
comparison: A caretaker applicant and chair differ from an inn visitor and a doorway.
seedUse: D147-a chair consent and redundancy; S02-a permits the practical adjustment while retaining the apology requirement.
